```

head(soil, n = 5)
dim(soil)
names(soil)
```

H0: There is no difference between lead in drip line and yard.
Ha: Lead is elevated in the drip line compared to the rest of the yard.

## Calculate the observed value of the statistic
Difference in means between samples from the drip line and the yard
```{r}
means <- soil |>  
    summarise(mean_pb_ppm = mean(pb_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = location_code)

diff_means <- means$mean_pb_ppm[2] - means$mean_pb_ppm[1] # DL - YD
```

```{r}
soil |> 
    count(location_code)
```

## Shuffle the predictor variable and recalculate the statistic

```{r}
shuffled_location <- sample(x = soil$location_code, size = length(soil$location_code), replace = FALSE)
shuffled_location
```


```{r}
randomized_df <- soil |> 
    mutate(location_code = shuffled_location)
randomized_df
```

```{r}
recalc_means <- randomized_df |>  
    summarise(mean_pb_ppm = mean(pb_ppm, na.rm = TRUE),
    .by = location_code)

recalc_diff <- recalc_means$mean_pb_ppm[2] - recalc_means$mean_pb_ppm[1] # DL - YD
```
